description: Custom cyberpunk icon set for the Savant CLI: the 10 canonical ECHO agent roles and 5 protocol marks, hand-authored as vector geometry in the canonical Savant neon palette. No external assets, no icon fonts, no downloaded content.

icons.name: Thinker
